a: UX is the overall experience a person has using a product.
UI is the visual and interactive interface of a product.
Wireframes are low-fidelity layouts of screens.
Prototypes simulate interaction before full implementation.
Accessibility ensures people with disabilities can use the product.
Affordances suggest how an element can be used.
UI feedback confirms that an action worked or failed.
Consistent patterns reduce the need for users to relearn.
Mobile-first designs the small screen first, then expands.
